name: atlas-e2e
description: Playwright E2E harness for atlas — Phase 8.2. Critical-path coverage on the live geospatial control room: the live map loads with the fleet MOVING over exactly ONE WebSocket (no polling XHR loop — the senior signal), a focused vehicle's ETA decrements, a geofence event fires and lands on the feed (driven by the deterministic demo affordance, never an organic sleep), the no-WebGL fleet-table fallback renders the same live data over one socket, prefers-reduced-motion keeps the map live, keyboard focus flows through the fleet list, and a socket drop shows the reconnect indicator. Runs against the BUILT + SERVED production stack behind a same-origin proxy so the strict connect-src 'self' CSP covers the WS (the meld/razors-edge/pulse prod-CSP lesson). Lighthouse CI (lighthouserc.json) gates the /about SEO surface at >= 95 x4.
